changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION logos_stats_rollup_window( p_start timestamptz, p_end timestamptz, p_use_rollup boolean, p_max_staleness interval DEFAULT interval '15 minutes' ) RETURNS TABLE (mv_lo timestamptz, mv_hi timestamptz) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path = public, pg_catalog AS $$ WITH lo AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN p_start = date_trunc('hour', p_start) THEN p_start ELSE date_trunc('hour', p_start) + interval '1 hour' END AS mv_lo ), watermark AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN NOT p_use_rollup THEN '-infinity'::timestamptz WHEN s.processed_through IS NULL THEN '-infinity'::timestamptz WHEN now() - s.processed_through > p_max_staleness THEN '-infinity'::timestamptz ELSE date_trunc('hour', s.processed_through) END AS ts FROM (SELECT processed_through FROM log_entry_rollup_state) s RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) one ON TRUE ) SELECT lo.mv_lo, GREATEST( LEAST(date_trunc('hour', p_end + interval '1 microsecond'), (SELECT ts FROM watermark)), lo.mv_lo) FROM lo; $$;

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS logos_stats_rollup_window(timestamptz, timestamptz, boolean, interval);
